review.notes: Token-level diff of extracted text from all 21 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown; 3 HTML tables render with balanced structure. All ten numbered footnotes had dropped bodies while their markers (including the safety table's $Evaluation^2$ header cell) survive; all restored and the two verified at 300 dpi (footnotes 2 and 4). Two page-break-split sentences rejoined as printed. Benchmark-table headers verified at 300 dpi and de-glued. Remaining deltas are hyphenation joins and figure-internal chart labels. The printed 'Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental (05-06)' pairing, 'capability. change.' and 'Model cards may be updated' lowercase spellings are the print's own and preserved.
